    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and
                last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Server-assigned customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>',
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a per-city
                4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: SYD-SMI-0007
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Server-assigned stable identifier shared by all owners of the
                same household (same last name and address). Owners that opt in with
                sharesHousehold receive the same value.
              type: string
              example: 3a7bd3e2360a3d29eea436fcfb7e44c735d117c42d1c1835420b6b9942dd4f1b
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first
                and last name (case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Derived membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: SYD-SMI-0007-M26
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: Derived membership tier. 'SILVER' when the owner has no
                namesakes (namesakeCount is 0) and an email is present, otherwise
                'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              example: SILVER
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: Derived locality (canonical region) resolved from the owner's
                city using a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'

          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException

        status:
          title: Status

          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp

          type: string
          format: date-time

          readOnly: true

          type: array

      required:
        - type
        - title

        - timestamp

      title: Validation message

      type: object

          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; when omitted
            on creation it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'

          title: Shares household

            already has the same last name and address (they share a household).
            Input only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false

        - city

    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and
                last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Server-assigned customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>',
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a per-city
                4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: SYD-SMI-0007
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID

              type: string
              example: 3a7bd3e2360a3d29eea436fcfb7e44c735d117c42d1c1835420b6b9942dd4f1b

              format: int32
              minimum: 0

              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:

All tests pass and the build succeeds. Here's what I implemented for the bulk-signup warning rule.

## Summary

The spec: on `POST /api/owners`, when **more than 80** owners were already created on the new owner's business day, the response (and every later read) carries `bulkSignupWarning: true`, otherwise `false`. The existing `AcceptanceTest` creates an owner and reads it back via `GET`, asserting the field is `false` — so the flag has to be persisted on the entity, exactly like the existing `namesakeCount`.

I followed the established per-owner-attribute pattern (mirroring `namesakeCount`):

1. **Persistence** — added a `bulk_signup_warning BOOLEAN` column to all four DB schemas (hsqldb — used by tests — plus h2/mysql/postgres) and a `Boolean bulkSignupWarning` field with getter/setter on the `Owner` entity.

2. **API contract** — added the `bulkSignupWarning` read-only boolean property to the `Owner` schema in `openapi.yml`, so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes it and MapStruct maps it by name automatically (no mapper change needed, same as `namesakeCount`).

3. **New pipeline step** — `FlagBulkSignup` counts owners already registered on the new owner's effective business day and sets the flag when `count > 80`. Wired into `owners.POST.yml` after `countNamesakes` and before `save`, so it runs after `ResolveRegistrationDate` (business-day-adjusted date is on the entity) and before persistence (the new owner isn't self-counted).

4. **Reuse instead of duplication** — the day-counting loop existed already inside `EnsureDailyLimit` (the hard ≥100 cap). Rather than copy it, I extracted it into a small shared `DailyRegistrations.countOn(repository, businessDay)` helper and pointed both the hard limit and the new soft warning at it. `FlagBulkSignup` is a soft warning (>80) sitting below `EnsureDailyLimit`'s hard cap (≥100), and both count the same owners the same way.

`Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` · `BUILD SUCCESS`.
